nodes_map_digest: SHA256 of json.dumps(registry["nodes"], sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"); validate exact identity types and871-alias coverage first
registry_byte_digest: SHA256 of exact registry file bytes at the delivered milestone; expected to differ when status/timestamps change
sidecar_policy: Do not add new fields to pinned registry schema. Put these delivery fields in separate milestone receipt files and journal records.
invariants: IDS_ALLOCATED and VERIFIED nodes_map_sha256 must match exactly; no silent reassignment
registry file and receipt hashes are independently recomputed byROOT and each proof author
VERIFIED must reference actual collected native evidence, not a proposed graph or generated expected receipt
PUBLISHING statuses and any local synthetic registry cannot qualify final proof; all live body/ID/parent/edge/metadata checks still required
